headline: LUXURY
chyron: BOSSES ORDER STAFF IN TO "FEEL THE CULTURE"
ticker: CEO EXPLAINS OFFICE CULTURE FROM HIS YACHT
HOT DESKS NOW HOT: NOBODY HAS FIXED THE AIR CON
COMMUTERS JOIN PRINTERS' UNION. TALKS JAMMED
BUS 47 SIGHTED. PASSENGERS ASK FOR A SELFIE

beats.text: Tonight: offices order staff back in, five days a week, to "feel the culture."
Workers report a forty-minute commute to sit on video calls with people in the same building.
Forty minutes? Luxury. I used to commute two hours. Uphill. Both ways.
Two hours? I commuted in a shoebox. On the motorway. In the fast lane.
A shoebox! We used to DREAM of a shoebox. I commuted inside a printer.
A printer? You were lucky. I was faxed in. Every morning. In pieces. Some of me is still in Leeds.
You were LUCKY. I drive the bus. I commute to my own commute.
And you tell the young people that today, and they won't believe you.
They won't, Brock. They work from home. They're watching this in pyjamas.
PYJAMAS?! In MY day we wore SUITS to the PUDDLE!

realStory.text: Made up for the show, but drawn from life: many employers have pushed for more office days since 2022. The one-upmanship comes from the Four Yorkshiremen sketch (1967), later a Monty Python stage favourite.

signoff: Terry gave everyone a lift home. He was late. On purpose. They had a lovely time.
